items.question: Is 'only the rows in force, each event once' the reading of 'what the record shows executed' for C-Q08-1, the record pause and trainedAfter?
items.evidenceStatus: definitional reading of decided rule C-Q08-1; consistent with r6-provenance supersededRows ('never accepted, counted or bound again') and with every other V1 reader; no scientific claim added
rationale: A replaced row is the record's history of a report, not a second session; counting it credits training the record shows happened at most once.

Correction to not done: no execution remains; the pause lengthens (P2 3->10 d; P3 3->40 d) and the bound lowers; the e2e equals the direct not-done control. A longer record pause can only make C-Q08-2 start lower or ask a reason, never prescribe more.

Corrections up or down: only the value in force counts (P4a 60, P4b 43, e2e 55 / 40, each equal to its direct control). An upward correction in force legitimately raises the bound above the uncorrected record; its authorship is SEC-CORE-03 (C-F01-3).
trainedAfter: a post-declaration session corrected to not done no longer counts as training after the declaration, so the declaration stands for the stop; judged by code.

items.question: Is the dose change confined to removing double credit, never reducing where distinct valid executions exist and never raising?
rationale: On every engine-produced record tested, candidate = in-force control and candidate <= base: p14 60->50 (all four shapes); AIF 40/40/40+80 -> 25/25/25+60 (= control); x2/x3, device, late, reordered, A->B->C; my e2e for not done, half, +20.
No reduction where distinct executions exist: unit 8 (eight distinct, three orders), unit 10, unit 11; once() never lets a non-execution occupy an eventId.

findings.severity: non-blocking; pre-existing, now reachable through a correction
findings.statement: C-Q08-1 bounds only when rows.some(executed); the record pause is read only from an executed session. When a correction removes the record's last execution in force, the stated exposure stands unbounded and no pause is read (P1: 600/7 vs base 13/1 via the phantom row).
findings.notCreatedByFix: identical on both trees for the same record reported not done directly (P1-control); worst case = the intake self-report, the accepted cold-start envelope (HQ-R6-COLD-START)
findings.whyAFinding: C-Q08-1 reads 'in the period it covers': a record holding this athlete's reported sessions in the window, all not done, shows zero, not unknown; asymmetric with P3 (one 40-day-old execution -> bound 0/0, 5-week pause)
findings.owner: next Core mission; reading to choose (bound to the window, or ASK confirmation against 'the record shows no training') needs its own SSCTR review

residuals.class: record custody / integrity (QRE, Security), not a sporting rule
residuals.statement: restartIntake reads the record as given. Self-contradicting records the engine does not produce: P5 same eventId with different minutes (first listed wins: 50 or 58; base 70); P6 a stale unflagged copy of a replaced original beside its correction (63 vs control 50; base 75; still F01-class double credit); P7 strength and run sharing an eventId (run dropped: 38 vs 50). Each <= base. once() covers identical copies only, not a union of pre- and post-correction snapshots.
